steps.code:
import re

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_files/"
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type="files")

# Parse each file name: <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
for file_path in files:
    # file_path is like "/home/adam/documents/work/meetings_files/2023-apr-03__slides.ppt"
    # Extract the basename
    basename = file_path.split("/")[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = basename.split("__", 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    # Split on last dot to get file_name and extension
    file_name, extension = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    # Desired directory: base_dir + file_name
    dest_dir = base_dir + file_name
    # Create directory if not exists (recursive not needed as base exists)
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dest_dir)
    # Desired file path: dest_dir + "/" + date_part + "." + extension
    dest_file = dest_dir + "/" + date_part + "." + extension
    # Move the file
    print(f"Moving {file_path} to {dest_file}")
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_file)
